scenario: Lexer rule local to `~` and `!~` per LREG.10.8 — the regex-start lexer state is activated specifically by the `~` and `!~` operators. Pin: both operators compile cleanly in the same rule.
rules_ds:
schema Log scope logical:
    msg: String key
    level: String mutable

rule r:
    Log e where e.msg ~ /^ERROR:/ and e.level !~ /^DEBUG/
->
    log info "error non-debug"
